title: Project Backup: every project gets a private GitHub repo
summary: At the start of any project, Claude initialises git, writes a sensible .gitignore (keeps secrets and huge files out), creates a PRIVATE GitHub repo and registers it for nightly automatic backup.
how_to_use: Say "back up this project" or "set up a repo", or let it run when you start a new project.
requires: GitHub CLI (gh) logged in. macOS for the nightly LaunchAgent.
